clue.text: Outstanding feature of animal crossing river

indicators.note: the animal word spans the river letter, so one sits across the other, holding it inside

parts.note: a beast is any animal

explanation.surface: A beast wading across a river, with some striking feature on show.
explanation.definitionFit: A bosom or chest sticks out from the body, so it is literally a protruding feature.

clue.text: Times approve such an operation

parts.note: by means times in multiplication, as in four by three
to pass a measure is to approve it

explanation.surface: A newspaper signing off a surgical procedure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper but is the multiplication word.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart surgery that reroutes blood around a blockage is a well-known type of operation.

clue.text: Reproduce special about work of a bishop

indicators.note: the shuffled letters surround the work piece
to reproduce is to make again, so the letters are remade in another order

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Copying a special piece of a cleric's work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reproduce' gives EPISCAL from the clue's adjective, and 'about' wraps those letters round the work; the surface's copying is a false trail.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective means governed by or relating to bishops.

clue.text: Good leaders — they offer no resistance

parts.note: super means very good
conductors lead orchestras

explanation.surface: Praise for submissive bosses who never push back.
explanation.definitionFit: Certain materials cooled to very low temperatures carry current with zero electrical resistance.

clue.text: Highly-charged vote in ruins if counted at first

parts.note: to vote someone in is to elect them

indicators.note: only the opening letter of each of the three following words is taken

explanation.surface: A tense, heated ballot where the result depends on whether spoiled papers are counted.
explanation.definitionFit: Electric describes an atmosphere so tense or thrilling it seems charged with current.

clue.text: Yob from university coming into fortune?

indicators.note: the university letter enters the fortune word

parts.note: your lot is your fortune or destiny

explanation.surface: A thug from a college coming into money.
explanation.definitionFit: A yob is a rowdy, uncouth youth, a synonym.

clue.text: Men cite Britain's troubled politician

indicators.note: something troubled is disturbed, so the letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: People pointing to Britain's problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior government member sitting in the top team is a politician.

clue.text: Treasure-trove keeps evoking the past

indicators.note: the run of letters is held inside the phrase, kept in its middle

explanation.surface: A hoard of buried treasure stirring up history.
explanation.definitionFit: Something retro imitates older styles, so it recalls bygone times.

clue.text: Endless resource underpinning cold minister's scissure

indicators.note: in a down clue the shortened resource sits below the other letters

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
Rev, Reverend, is a minister's title

indicators.note: the final letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: an asset is a resource

explanation.surface: Supporting a cold clergyman's split.
explanation.definitionFit: A scissure is a split or cleft, and a deep crack in a glacier is just that.

clue.text: Note to follow strait-laced grooms

indicators.note: the note comes after the prudish word in the build

parts.note: prim and strait-laced both mean prudishly proper
PS, a postscript, is a note added at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A prim note telling someone to follow a strict line on how they groom.
explanation.definitionFit: To primp is to tidy and smarten oneself, a synonym for grooming.

clue.text: Tabloid articles about bishop's tan

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
A and THE are the indefinite and definite articles

explanation.surface: Gossip papers running pieces about a cleric's holiday tan.
explanation.definitionFit: To tan is to bronze the skin by lying in the sun, which is what sunbathing does.

clue.text: Clues with no beginning may keep listener visibly upset

indicators.note: the shortened clue word holds the listener inside
the opening letter of the synonym is removed

parts.note: hints are clues
an ear is the organ that listens

explanation.surface: Cryptic clues that baffle the solver and make them weep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no beginning' cuts HINTS to INTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone crying is plainly distressed for all to see.

clue.text: Managing to get copper band after store emptied

indicators.note: the metal and band come after the emptied store
the inside letters of the shop word are removed, leaving its two ends

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a ring is a circular band

explanation.surface: Someone getting a copper ring once the shop has been cleared out.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to obtain it, so securing is succeeding in acquiring.

clue.text: A record backed by a new nation

indicators.note: the reversed part sits beside the article and new letter
the first article and the record are read from back to front

parts.note: a log is a written record, like a ship's log

explanation.surface: A disc reversed alongside a newly founded country.
explanation.definitionFit: This southwest African country is a sovereign state, so it counts as a nation.

clue.text: Squirrels away remains under stone

indicators.note: in a down clue the remains sit below the weight letters

parts.note: st is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight
ashes are what remains after a fire or cremation

explanation.surface: Burying cremated remains beneath a headstone.
explanation.definitionFit: To squirrel away is to hide a hoard, as a squirrel hides nuts.

clue.text: Favouring trial on it as fresh objections

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a test is a trial

indicators.note: fresh signals that these letters are made anew in a different order

explanation.surface: Backing a trial on something fresh, despite people raising objections.
explanation.definitionFit: These are formal declarations of dissent, so they are emphatic objections.

clue.text: How church music should be arranged?

definitions.text: How church music should be arranged?

parts.words: How church music should be arranged?
parts.note: arranged means put in order, but read as arranged for the instrument that plays in church

explanation.walkthrough: Read as music adapted for the church's keyboard instrument, it also means simply well-ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: Something properly arranged is well ordered and tidy.

clue.text: Accompanied from secret do in a tizzy

indicators.note: a tizzy is a flustered state, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Flustered at a clandestine party.
explanation.definitionFit: Being escorted means being accompanied by someone.

clue.text: Scally oddly dealing with sauce

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the word are kept, first, third and fifth

parts.note: to address a problem is to deal with it

explanation.surface: A scally behaving oddly while handling some cheek or sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: A scally is British slang for a young rogue; 'sauce' also suggests cheek, but here it is the condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinaigrette and other dressings are cold sauces poured on leaves.

clue.text: Emergency situations created by increase in vacant chalets

indicators.note: the growth word goes inside the emptied holiday huts
vacant means empty, so only the outer letters remain

parts.note: a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A shortage of guests at holiday chalets causing alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of crisis, a time of acute danger or difficulty.

clue.text: One in high church position of responsibility

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the combined high and church letters

parts.note: meat that is high has gone off
CE is the Church of England
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone holding a lofty position in the church.
explanation.definitionFit: An office is a post carrying duties, such as the office of mayor.

clue.text: Wife ignores boxing act

indicators.note: the two words box the run of letters, enclosing it

explanation.surface: A spouse turning a blind eye to a boxing match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxing' looks like the sport but means enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: To act is to pretend, put on a show of feeling.

clue.text: Symbol found in expensive-sounding sort of gear

indicators.note: the symbol word is placed inside the other piece
the word for expensive is used for its sound, spelt as the animal

parts.note: dear means costly
a sign is a symbol

explanation.surface: A symbol on pricey kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Designer gear is clothing bearing a famous label, a type of costly fashion.

clue.text: List of workers on turn?

parts.note: men are workers, as in management and men
a U-turn is a turn, so U stands for one

explanation.surface: A list of who works which shift.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill of fare is a list of dishes.

clue.text: Fashion Dior et al made to measure

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape, so these letters are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: Couture houses like Dior making bespoke clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailored garment is cut to fit one person, so it is bespoke.

clue.text: Way a sibling creates state of inactivity

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
sis is short for sister, a sibling

explanation.surface: Siblings stuck in a rut together.
explanation.definitionFit: Stasis is stagnation, a condition where nothing changes or moves.

clue.text: Person unwilling to adapt is around, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Lament that a stubborn person is still about.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, an old-fashioned person who resists change is likened to an extinct reptile.

clue.text: Second-class journeys for people getting hitched

parts.note: B is a second-class grade
rides are journeys

explanation.surface: Cheap travel for couples on their way to the wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Women being married are the main figures at a wedding.
